en: You really want to turn back? After you got the map sussed out and everything?
...there's no wind. It's an ill-omen.
Oh my god Magnus, you're so dramatic! All I need to you do to is steer, alright? I'll handle the scary stuff.
Felicia-
You can't change my mind, sorry! I spent too long planning this. Anyway, we'll be there in a few hours.
...be where, exactly?
Right... I didn't really explain it yet, huh?
I've asked several times. You always wriggle out of it.
Well, I've got nowhere to wriggle now, do I?
Close your eyes, my love. And be still.
For this is the end and the beginning.
[Whoosh]
The rain is incessant - but it's oddly localised - like a local biome.
Ask for a man named Solomon Stonetop.
The fluid, what I [i]believe[/i] to be amniotic fluid, is being diluted. I'm curious to see what happens.
We... believe it was [i]born[/i] here. Long ago. How long I cannot say.
We... found traces of its pilgrimage to the South.
It's barren for some miles, until of course, you near the coast.
Follow the line and you'd come to a small settlement known as [i]Silkwirm.[/i]
It... may be endangered, or it may hold a position of insight. I'm not sure.
I'd like to suggest one of you travel there and find out.
Faustus, I thought perhaps this might interest [i]you,[/i] in particular.
Come on, give it up. Just let me take it-
I'm sorry, Tanya. I cannot.
But why d'you even need-
I've told you before.
No, you [i]haven't[/i]. All you've ever told me is that you're-
I'd like to request that you return to your room.
I have something I must attend to.
Hey. Listen - why don't we just kill him?
That helps both of us!
If he dies, we're both free, right?
Come on, I know you don't have any better ideas.
The Star-Gazing Girl stares into the ink-black void.
Upon her trembling lips, a question born.
A forbidden query of what may be and what may not be.
The void, unyielding to the girl's plight, stares back. It speaks;
Close your eyes, my love. And be still. For this is the end and the beginning.
[Whoosh]
[Scream]
[Thud]
[Static]
[Phone Ringing]
[Beep]
Hello? Who's this?
My name is Magnus Mortuga.
Oh yeah? Just happen to have my number, do you? Listen buddy-
I'm not lying to you. You and I share a mutual acquaintance, and she has informed me of your skillset.
I wish to hire you - and I believe I have something I can offer in payment.
I'm listening. What are you after?
I'm in need of information. Information about a woman named Felicia Stonetop.
[Static]
[Static]

-I really don't know why you're here, this doesn't concern you-
There's something inside...
Wait... what's this?
